projects.title: Accuracy vs. Interpretability in Designer-Level Fashion Classification
projects.subtitle: Designer-level fashion classification with interpretability analysis
projects.summary: Studied how model complexity and training strategies impact model performance on deisgner classification and model interpretability.

projects.title: Beat-the-Expert: An IL-RL Framework to Outperform Expert Racing Policies
projects.subtitle: Bootstrapping PPO with HG-DAGGER imitation learning for F1TENTH racing
projects.summary: Bootstrapped PPO with a pre-trained HG-DAGGER policy to improve sample efficiency in autonomous racing, surpassing the easiest expert demonstration but falling short on harder expert traces.

projects.title: Learning Spatial Pass Feasibility Under Partial Observability in Soccer
projects.subtitle: Estimating pass feasibility from sparse freeze-frame state tensors
projects.summary: Studied whether interpretable pass probability surfaces can be learned from sparse event-aligned snapshots using structured spatial representations and controlled ablations.

projects.title: SoccerIQ-Function: Offline Q-Function Evaluation for Estimating Soccer Action Rewards
projects.subtitle: Offline evaluation of long-horizon action value from historical match data
projects.summary: Estimate the long-term value of soccer actions using offline Q-function evaluation with spatial state representations and structured action features.

projects.title: Particle Filter SLAM on KITTI LiDAR
projects.subtitle: Coursework implementation of particle-filter SLAM with occupancy grid mapping
projects.summary: Implemented the particle-filter SLAM steps on KITTI LiDAR data using a provided skeleton, focusing on dynamics, observation updates, resampling, and occupancy grid mapping.

projects.title: CrazyFlie Trajectory Planning and Control in a Maze
projects.subtitle: Quadrotor controller, waypoint planner, and trajectory generation on real hardware
projects.summary: Deployed a full CrazyFlie 2.0 stack for stable hover, gain tuning, waypoint planning, and maze navigation with VICON tracking feedback.

projects.title: Autonomous Quadrotor Navigation in 3D Occupancy Maps
projects.subtitle: Integrated planning, trajectory generation, and state estimation for end-to-end autonomy
projects.summary: Integrated discretization, search-based planning, trajectory generation, and state estimation into a single autonomous quadrotor navigation pipeline.

projects.title: Unscented Kalman Filtering for 3D Orientation Estimation
projects.subtitle: Quaternion UKF with IMU calibration and Vicon ground truth
projects.summary: Implemented a quaternion-based UKF for 3D orientation estimation from raw IMU data, with a full sensor calibration pipeline and Vicon-based evaluation.
